title: Angelic Guardians of the Dark Castle
description: A majestic blue and gold winged angel with a halo embraces two crowned women holding white lilies. They stand in the foreground as a dark gothic cathedral looms behind them under a fiery red sky filled with dragons and bats.
prompt: A majestic angel with large blue and gold feathered wings and a halo, wearing a white and orange patterned robe, gently embraces two young crowned queens in dark blue gowns who are holding white lilies. They stand before a towering dark gothic cathedral with spires under a dramatic fiery red and orange sky filled with flying dragons and bats, swirling ethereal energy surrounds them, highly detailed digital fantasy painting.
